tactic: Keep one standing front on the live GitHub constraint named by scripts/flow-metrics --constraint and a second front on the next measured bottleneck.

necessary.statement: The live GitHub constraint is measured on tower/gate reliability, tower/gate latency, deploy latency and merge pace (flow-metrics --constraint).

parallel.statement: Attacking the measured constraint yields more than local optimization elsewhere (TOC five focusing steps).

sufficiency.statement: A reliable and fast tower/gate, a 1 s deploy and a fed queue lead to ladder step 1.
